annotation.bound_parties_text: The standard addresses design teams building and evaluating a safety case for vehicles (items) that can operate in an autonomous mode.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: with an expectation that design teams will include additional items as relevant to the item and its operational design domain
annotation.dates_quote: This New Edition of ANSI/UL 4600 dated March 17, 2023 includes the following changes in requirements:
annotation.legal_effect_quote: The requirements of this standard are considered to be at a necessary, but possibly not sufficient, level of completeness and rigor to create an acceptably well-formed and acceptably complete item safety case.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This standard covers the safety principles, risk mitigation, tools, techniques, and lifecycle processes for building and evaluating a safety argument for vehicles that can operate in an autonomous mode
